summary.title: Summary
summary.text1: I am a detail-oriented UX/UI product designer and 3D artist dedicated to creating immersive and intuitive digital experiences. With a background in Digital Communication and Entertainment, I have focused my career on bridging the gap between technical complexity and visual storytelling, ensuring that every interaction is as functional as it is aesthetically pleasing.
summary.text2: Throughout my career, I have specialized in 3D modeling, animation, and game development, mastering tools like Blender and Unity to bring interactive worlds to life. My approach combines a deep understanding of user-centered design with a solid technical foundation in C#, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, allowing me to collaborate effectively with development teams and transform high-fidelity prototypes into tangible realities.
summary.quote: Driven by curiosity and a commitment to innovation, I continuously explore the boundaries of interaction design, whether developing mobile games, creating interfaces, or bringing ideas to life through animation.

work.title: Work Experience
work.uxuiDesc1: I have focused my UX/UI design approach on creating interfaces that are not only aesthetically appealing but also deeply functional and user-centered.
work.uxuiDesc2: My work is based on translating complex business requirements into high-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and intuitive user flows that optimize conversion and improve usability.
work.uxuiDesc3: I possess a solid understanding of atomic design principles and industry-standard interaction patterns.
work.artDesc1: I have refined my skills in 3D art and animation to create digital assets that complement visual narrative and interaction design.
work.artDesc2: My approach ranges from clean polygonal modeling and detailed texturing to character rigging and animation, ensuring stylistic consistency and optimization for rendering engines or interactive applications.
work.artDesc3: I have developed the ability to translate abstract concepts into functional 3D assets with a professional aesthetic.
